claims.claim: Added a factory-only immutable CanonicalSellableVariant admission boundary requiring one exact approved SellableVariantDecisionRecord and one keyword-only, validated opaque variant_id.

Canonical variants retain the exact approval record and derive proposal, source family, family ID, and canonically ordered members solely through the preserved TASK-116 lineage without copying or rewriting.

Admission performs no upstream re-execution, identity generation, aggregation, persistence, uniqueness enforcement, catalog mutation, or external work and exposes no profile, catalog, retrieval, partition, or mutation authority.

Added focused deterministic regressions covering the bounded signature, APPROVE and REJECT behavior, opaque ID validation, singleton and multi-member lineage, anti-forgery immutability, repeated construction, schema exclusions, and zero upstream or external calls.

Updated M3 documentation to define canonical sellable-variant admission as the narrow post-TASK-116 identity-binding boundary and defer catalog uniqueness, reuse, idempotency, cross-record integrity, profile aggregation, retrieval, and RAG.
